root.label: Lyons and Scott testify they have no plans to send officers to polls

events.label: Lyons and Scott testify they have no plans to send officers to polls

slots.name: deployment of officers to polls
slots.sentence: During congressional testimony earlier this year, the then-acting head of Immigration and Customs Enforcement, Todd Lyons, and the head of Customs and Border Protection, Rodney Scott, said they had no plans to send officers to the polls.
